evidence: Cached native text/pdata decoded as data; current Rust sources read/edited only; no project/game loading or execution, builds, syntax checks, tests, GPU calls or process inspection

nativeFacts.framebuffer: Entry at renderer+c97690+handle*68; color texture handle words begin at +0, depth word at +10, color count byte at +32
nativeFacts.textureStride: b8, established by the resource-transition helper and registry ensure routine
nativeFacts.allocatedExtent: Registry+b8008, divided by b8 after exact divisibility/bounds checks
nativeFacts.extensionRoot: Registry+b8000 points to a root whose first word points to extension page one; subsequent pages link at page+b8000
nativeFacts.extensionMode: Only the observed zero-mode extension path is admitted; nonzero mode remains unknown
nativeFacts.resourceField: Texture entry+0 is loaded into ResourceBarrier's pResource field
nativeFacts.retirementMode: Texture entry+9b bit 40 bypasses ordinary df98520 resource retirement/slot clearing. The source reader now guards the entire byte and exposes its stable scalar value; this does not supply an allocation lease (native-texture-retirement-source.json).
nativeFacts.stateCacheRoot: Command context+14458 points to the same native texture registry

firstUseState.behavior: Appends a handle and stores the requested state into two cached words, setting validity; no immediate public ResourceBarrier call in the inspected body
firstUseState.inference: These cache words do not establish actual queued GPU resource state

sourcePort.integration: Lazy capture on an actual whole-resource unsplit transition inside the pinned framebuffer routine; depth_tracker forwards the real resource argument to native_framebuffer.transition
sourcePort.rootJoin: Context state-cache registry pointer must equal renderer+bde170
sourcePort.attachments: Copy selected color/depth handle fields; merge duplicate handle roles; skip ffff sentinel
sourcePort.lookup: Read existing native metadata only; never call native allocation/ensure/growth helpers; reject bad extents, pointers, cycles, unsupported extension mode and missing slots
sourcePort.objectJoin: Compare the copied slot pointer numerically with the actual public ID3D12Resource argument; never invoke COM through a guessed slot pointer
sourcePort.lifetime: Clone only the actual callback resource; a matching successful public committed-creation receipt can now also supply a retained committed-storage owner. Incomplete samples end with the native call, while a complete pair may transfer into the separately bounded native list binding shadow. See native-committed-resources-source.json and native-bound-surfaces-source.json; this is not an exclusive scene/allocator lease
sourcePort.rechecks: Framebuffer handle fields, registry/page/resource-pointer/retirement-mode copies and actual resource description must remain stable before a sample reports the join
sourcePort.stateFacts: Only report the observed public transition before/after values; split or partial/post-bind transition cohorts remain unknown
sourcePort.output: Bounded role/handle/description samples without addresses; matchedTextureResourceJoins counts logical texture-slot joins, not unique GPU objects or completed GPU barriers

limitations: Default swapchain resources use a separate path and are not resolved by this registry reader
An attachment with no matching public transition within the native call remains unobserved
First-use/deferred state initialization is not promoted to actual queue state

Resource-pointer correlation alone does not prove exact RTV/DSV mapping; native-surface-views-source.json records the subsequent bounded API-descriptor argument join, still without driver or live verification
Callback COM retention does not establish exclusive native rendering ownership or prevent later engine reuse
World/view/shader/group joins, native synchronization or state-restored insertion, actual drawing and verification remain unfinished
